requestedBy: User's exact seven-event nested model-selection instructions
outerEvents: Exactly the seven existing evaluated events, each with both observed supplier outcome classes
outerTraining: The other six evaluated events only; neither 2011 single-class event enters training or selection
innerLoop: Six leave-one-event-out folds inside each outer-training set; each candidate trains on five and predicts the sixth
selectionScore: Arithmetic mean of the six inner event AUCs; each event has equal weight
outerRefit: Refit the chosen candidate on all six outer-training events and score its point probabilities on the untouched outer event
mainModel: Candidate picked most often across the seven outer folds; ties use the same fixed candidate order
mainModelScope: Export own-event-held-out point predictions from the modal family. Its family was selected using the collection of folds, so its fixed-family score is descriptive; the nested fold-selected score is reported separately
distance: Existing distance_rule: exponential in minimum manufacturing-site distance; scale and prevalence calibration use training companies only

logistic.preprocessing: Training-only category encoder, median imputation with missing indicators, and standard scaling

lightgbm.roundSelection: Existing deterministic training-only nested_rounds; the lexicographically last training event selects rounds, after which all five/six training events are refit. An inner validation event or outer test event never supplies stopping labels

metricInterval: 95% percentile event-cluster bootstrap of seven saved outer predictions; no refitting or model reselection inside this uncertainty calculation
perEventInterval: 95% paired stratified company bootstrap conditional on each event's observed class counts
predictionInterval: Refit the main family on 200 event-bootstrap resamples of outer training; 2.5/97.5 percentiles, conservatively expanded to contain the full-training point prediction when necessary
unlocated2011Predictions: Fit the modal family on all seven evaluated events; retain the original company-only scopes and exclude these events from all metrics
featuresAndLabels: Frozen existing processed features and CAR labels; no changes based on any outer scores
priorKnowledge: Earlier LightGBM/baseline outer scores have already been seen. This new protocol is fixed before its own results, not claimed as prospectively preregistered before all prior analysis
noOuterTuning: No alternative candidates, feature changes, label changes, probability reversal, parameter search, or protocol edits after inspecting the new outer results
